recognize_zh: 三色染色中，骨髓腔被藍色膠原纖維取代並呈流線狀排列，其間有擴張的竇狀血管（內含紅血球）；兩側骨小樑增厚、不規則（紅色基質、藍色邊緣），表示膠原纖維化合併骨硬化，是原發性骨髓纖維化纖維化期（MF-3）的表現。
features: Intertrabecular space replaced by blue-staining collagen fibers in a streaming pattern
Dilated, tortuous sinusoids containing red cells and occasional nucleated cells
Scattered spindle and small hematopoietic nuclei within the fibrotic stroma; hematopoiesis markedly reduced
Thickened, irregular bony trabeculae (red) with blue-staining osteoid-like margins, indicating osteosclerosis
Scattered fat vacuoles; megakaryocyte morphology cannot be judged at this magnification
describe_en: Masson trichrome-stained bone marrow trephine section shows extensive blue collagen fibrosis with a streaming arrangement that replaces most of the hematopoietic space. Dilated, tortuous sinusoids containing red cells are prominent. The adjacent bony trabeculae are thickened and irregular with new bone formation at their margins. Findings are consistent with collagen fibrosis and osteosclerosis (MF-3), as seen in the fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis; correlation with reticulin grade, megakaryocyte morphology, leukoerythroblastic blood picture and driver mutation status is recommended.

ddx.vs: Histology is similar; the diagnosis depends on documented antecedent polycythemia vera or essential thrombocythemia.
Osteitis fibrosa shows peritrabecular fibrosis with osteoclastic resorption (tunneling) and preserved central hematopoiesis rather than diffuse streaming collagen with dilated sinusoids.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular or perivascular fibrotic lesions containing spindle mast cells that are tryptase and CD25 positive.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma (e.g. breast, prostate) with osteosclerosis
ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma shows keratin-positive epithelial clusters within the fibrosis.
